title: The 12 Best Anime to Watch if You Think You Hate Anime
summary: Despite its ferocious popularity, people still tend to swear off anime entirely. Take a trip back to the anime of the ’80s, when writer-director Hayao Miyazaki was helping redefine what Japanese animation could accomplish—even before he cofounded Studio Ghibli.
